biomarkers.name: RET mutations (germline in MEN2A/2B/FMTC; somatic in sporadic)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~95-98% germline in hereditary; ~40-65% somatic in sporadic (M918T most common and associated with aggressive behavior)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Selpercatinib and pralsetinib highly effective in RET-mutant advanced MTC; genetic counselling and prophylactic thyroidectomy in MEN2 kindreds

biomarkers.name: RAS mutations (HRAS, KRAS)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~10-25% of sporadic cases, enriched in RET-wildtype tumors

biomarkers.name: Calcitonin
biomarkers.clinical_use: Definitive diagnostic marker for MTC; calcitonin doubling time is a key prognostic factor; monitoring post-thyroidectomy

biomarkers.name: CEA
biomarkers.clinical_use: Complementary monitoring; CEA doubling time is also prognostic

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Nested or trabecular growth of polygonal to spindle cells with amyloid stroma (calcitonin-derived amyloid)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: International MTC grading system (mitoses, necrosis, Ki-67 proliferation)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Poorly characterised; less inflamed than PTC
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Distinctive amyloid stroma (calcitonin-derived) — pathognomonic when present

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Ultimobranchial body-derived C cells; distinct from endoderm-derived follicular epithelium of other major thyroid cancers
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains C-cell neuroendocrine differentiation with calcitonin and CEA production
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Neuroendocrine phenotype is usually preserved; sporadic RET M918T mutation is associated with more aggressive behaviour and parallels MEN2B germline biology
